title: Austin Appoints New City Manager
summary:
*   A special meeting focused on confidential discussions regarding potential land acquisitions, legal issues, and personnel matters.
*   Following these private discussions, the council officially appointed Dr. Camille Gates Barnett as Austin's new City Manager.
*   Dr. Barnett's appointment was a unanimous decision, with her tenure as the city's chief administrator set to begin on March 20, 1989.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - February 16, 1989 - 8:30 A.M Council Chambers, 307 V\tst Second
Street, Austin. Texas Mayor Cooke called to order the special called meeting of the
Council, noting the presence of all Councilmembers. The Mayor announced the purpose of the
meeting was to go into Executive Session, pursuant to Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil
Statutes Annotated, to discuss matters of land acquisition, litigation, and for personnel
matters.
No final action, decision or vote by the City Council will be taken on any subject or
matter unless specifically listed on the agenda for this meeting.
1. Personnel Matters - Section 2, Paragraph g
(a) City Manager Search
Council recessed their meeting for executive session at 8:57 A.M. and resumed its recessed
meeting at 12:20 P.M. CITY MANAGER APPOINTED The Council, on Mayor Pro Tern Shipman's
motion, Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's second, appointed Dr. Camille Gates Barnett as City
Manager of Austin, Texas, beginning March 20, 1989. (7-0 Vote). ADJOURNMENT After
answering questions from the news media, Council adjourned its meeting at 12:30 P.M.
